description: Per-slot test metrics of every run behind paper Table I, as written by train_cmkd.py / train_vision_only.py to cmkd_results/<run>/eval_results.npz at the end of training (top1, top3, top5: per-slot top-k accuracy; dba: per-slot DBA score; slots t, t+1, ..., t+6; fractions, not percent). Collected with src/collect_table1.py.
